note: The snowshoe prints still carry the woodshed hint field, but their text no longer says where they lead, so the woodshed's pointer lock does not point in the fiction and never names the spot it opens.

patch.value: Big round prints with a criss-cross pattern. Snowshoe prints, not paws! They lead toward the woodshed, right to the big woodpile.
